Author: Sansflaire
Name: FFXIV Miscellaneous Challenges
Description: A tracker for miscellaneous self-imposed FFXIV challenges across combat, exploration, gathering, crafting and social play. Challenges complete themselves when their conditions are met - walk a route, emote at a spot, ride a particular mount somewhere, or wear a full outfit in a given zone - and a popup celebrates each one. Progress is kept per install with the date you finished each challenge, and a separate permanent record means a reset is always recoverable. Includes a suggestion button for sending ideas straight to the developer. Commands: /tchallenges, /tchal
